home.subtitle: Paste your code and get detailed technical feedback: bugs, performance, and style. No API key. Your code is never executed.

noKey.title: No API key
noKey.description: The AI runs on a local server. No account or API key required.

private.title: Private by design
private.description: Your code is analyzed as data, never executed. Saved to your history only if you sign in.

local.title: Local AI
local.description: Ollama runs on the server. No API costs. No third-party dependencies.

howItWorks.title: From pasted snippet to useful review in three steps
howItWorks.description: The experience is designed for practicing code review without preparing repositories, branches, or simulated pull requests.

paste.title: Paste a snippet
paste.description: Use the editor to paste real code or load a sample. The app treats it as text, not as executable input.

choose.title: Choose the focus
choose.description: Ask for a general review or focus the analysis on bugs, security, performance, testing, or architecture.

learn.title: Learn from the feedback
learn.description: Get a summary, prioritized findings, and practical suggestions for improving the code.

reviewTypes.title: Choose the kind of review you need
reviewTypes.description: Each mode steers the response toward a specific technical review skill, from spotting bugs to thinking about design.

general.description: A balanced review for getting a first read on the code.

cleanCode.description: Flags unclear names, duplication, readability issues, and small design choices.

bugs.description: Looks for logic errors, edge cases, and unexpected behavior.

security.description: Reviews common risks such as weak validation, data exposure, or over-trusting inputs.

performance.description: Finds expensive operations, avoidable loops, and opportunities to simplify.

architecture.description: Analyzes responsibility boundaries, coupling, and clarity between layers.

testing.description: Suggests test cases and scenarios that help build confidence.

learning.title: Feedback designed to explain the why
learning.description: The goal is not only to find issues: it is to help you practice the reasoning behind a real technical review.

explain.title: Explains the impact
explain.description: Each finding should make clear what happens, why it matters, and when it can become a problem.

prioritize.title: Prioritizes what matters
prioritize.description: Severity levels help separate small improvements from risks worth fixing first.

improve.title: Suggests a direction
improve.description: Suggestions are written so you can act, compare alternatives, and improve your judgment.

privacy.title: Designed to analyze code without executing it
privacy.description: The app keeps review, persistence, and AI boundaries separate. Pasted code is treated as untrusted input.

noExecution.title: No execution
noExecution.description: No eval, compilation, or execution is performed on user-submitted code.

serverSide.title: Server-side AI
serverSide.description: The Ollama request runs on the server side so internal details are not exposed to the client.

optionalHistory.title: Optional history
optionalHistory.description: Reviews are saved to history only when the user signs in.

noPaidApi.title: No public AI costs
noPaidApi.description: The MVP uses local AI by default and does not pass external provider costs to the owner.

finalCta.title: Start with a small snippet and train your review judgment
finalCta.description: Paste code, choose a focus, and compare the response with what you would have commented in a real review.

faqs.title: Quick questions
faqs.description: The basics for understanding how to use the app, what is saved, and what to expect from the review experience.

signIn.question: Do I need to sign in?
signIn.answer: Not to try the reviewer. You only need to sign in if you want to keep a history of your reviews.

savedCode.question: Is my code saved?
savedCode.answer: It is saved as part of a review only if you are signed in. It may also be kept temporarily to recover an in-progress review.

apiKey.question: Do I need an API key?
apiKey.answer: No. The current setup uses Ollama as the local provider and does not require external keys.

execution.question: Does the app execute my code?
execution.answer: No. Code is analyzed as text and is never executed, compiled, or sandboxed in the MVP.

docker.question: Can I run it locally?
docker.answer: Yes. The README includes a Docker Compose setup for running the app, PostgreSQL, and Ollama.

cta.title: Try a real review
cta.description: If the flow is clear, paste a small snippet and read the feedback at your own pace.
